Usage: headroom headless place [flags]

Decide which account the next headless session spends, and record it.

Decides which account the caller's next headless session spends, records the decision as
load the person's own launches steer around, and prints it as JSON on stdout:
  {"schema": 1, "placed": bool, "account", "placement", "reason", "rule", "token_ends_at",
   "refusal", "retry_at", "notes": [...], "accounts": [{"account", "eligible", "excluded",
   "near_limit", "room_at", "load", "busy", "pending", "observed_at", "stale",
   "session", "week"}]}
It exits 0 placed, and 3 refused — every account it could take is near a limit or
excluded — with the document saying why and, in retry_at, when room returns (null when
waiting alone will not help). Report the session's process with headroom headless started
<placement> <pid>, and fetch the token with headroom headless token <account>.

Flags:
      --prefer=NAME     The account the session ran on last, followed while it has room so its
                        prompt cache stays warm.
      --exclude=NAME    An account not to take — one whose session ended on a usage limit, or whose
                        token the vendor refused; repeat for more (repeatable).
      --dry-run         Decide, and record nothing.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help            Show context-sensitive help.
      --version         Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                        exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
